name: perlin-dissolve
title: Perlin Dissolve
description: Organic noise grows over the outgoing scene until the frame is flooded with one color, then the incoming scene fades in. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D noise field instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .prd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: A long, atmospheric dissolve between two sections.
The brand color should flood the frame before the next scene appears.
avoidWhen: Fast cuts: the noise needs time to grow and settle.
The next scene must appear immediately.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Softness
variables.description: Softness of the edge between the two colors.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Multiplier for the noise’s own drift.
